judge_info.rule: One fixed judge pair for every run. Judges mark only the explanation of tutor items, and the explanation passes only when both judges pass it. When the candidate is in the family of either judge, or a judge is missing from the live model list, the explanation is not scored.

gold.note: Gold comes from the source files named on each item. Teanga Bench did not have native-speaker review. An item counts as human-checked only when its source file records human review. Judge marks on tutor explanations are made by models and are not human-validated.

Sentence: Byddai yna adar y tu allan er i fyddai merlod na defaid.
Reply with one JSON object and nothing …
failure_examples.expected: Byddai yna adar y tu allan er na fyddai merlod na defaid.
failure_examples.output: {"has_error": true, "error_span": "er i", "correction": "er na", "corrected_sentence": "Byddai yna adar y tu allan er na fyddai merlod na defaid.", "explanation": "A negative clause after 'er' with a conjugated verb takes the negative particle 'na' (er na fyddai…), not the preposition 'i'. 'Er i' is only used before a subject and verbnoun (e.g. 'er i mi fynd'), not before a conjugated verb like 'fyddai'."}
